senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) a slaughtering, sacrifice, esp. (festive) peace-offering (חֲגִיגָה).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 5:22">Tosef. Ber. V, 22</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>זְבָחִים</he>, constr. <he>זִבְחֵי</he>.
Zeb. I, 1 כל הז׳ all animalic offerings; a. fr.—Z’baḥim, name of a treatise of the Mishnah, Tosefta and Talmud Babli (also called שְׁחִיטַת קָדֳשִׁים).
